senses.sense_definition: Relating to or resulting from metabolism, the chemical processes in living organisms that sustain life.

examples.text: Regular exercise can help increase your <w>metabolic</w> rate and burn more calories.
The patient was diagnosed with a rare <w>metabolic</w> disorder affecting energy levels.

senses.sense_definition: Relating to metamorphosis or involving fundamental biological change.

examples.text: The insect undergoes several <w>metabolic</w> stages before emerging as a winged adult.
Scientists tracked the <w>metabolic</w> transformations occurring throughout the organism's development.

senses.sense_definition: A nutritional supplement intended to support or alter metabolic processes.

examples.text: The athlete added a specialized <w>metabolic</w> to his daily nutritional plan.
Doctors caution patients against using an untested <w>metabolic</w> to lose weight quickly.
